the scene at the time of the crime...

the tanner.
About Jack the Ripper...

Count Gordon.

Vanessa, the innkeeper...
She seems to be hiding some secret.
A man named Oliver who frequents the pub
seems to know something, but...
Whoa! Wh-what
who are you?
